verdict.rationale: Svelte is a compiler and framework whose source is published on GitHub. It is installed and run entirely on the user's own machine (`npx sv create`, `npm install`, `npm run dev`), and its builds produce plain HTML/JS/CSS or static sites via adapter-static that can be deployed anywhere, with no vendor-hosted dependency. missing for 10: explicit open-source license evidence, documentation framing self-hosting or vendor independence directly, independent corroboration of fully offline/self-run use.
